description: Upload a photo to a connected platform's media gallery (separate from posts). Today only google_business is wired.

account_id.description:
For `google_business`, the location resource name to upload to —
either fully-qualified `accounts/{accountId}/locations/{locationId}`
or the relative `locations/{locationId}` form. If omitted, the
workspace's default location is used.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

category.description:
Where the photo lands on the location's listing. `PROFILE`,
`LOGO`, and `COVER` replace the existing identity photos; the
rest append to the gallery.

description.description: Optional caption associated with the photo on Google's side.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

source_url.description:
Public URL of the image to upload. Must be reachable by Google's
servers. Use a `read_url` returned by `POST /media/upload-url` for
files stored in Aidelly.

name: aidelly_create_photo
